But the correction here is (product*3327)&65535 — for REDC you need m' such that (product + product*m'*Q) ≡ 0 mod 2^16, i.e. product*(1+m'*Q) ≡ 0 mod 2^16 → m' ≡ -Q^{-1} mod 2^16. 3327 = Q-2; need check whether -Q^{-1} mod 65536 = 3327. Great — so 3327 is indeed the right constant (m' with Q*m' ≡ -1). So REDC correction is correct. Good, don't claim that.

Actually verify: 3329*3327 = 11,075,583. 65536*169 = 11,075,584. Yes! diff = -1. So constant correct.

Actually coefficient stored mod Q so ≤ 3328. So product ≤ 3328*3328 ≈ 11.07M. reduced ≈ product/65536 + ... ≤ 169 + Q.
